home.title: 670Send — Parcel delivery across Timor-Leste
home.description: Send parcels between all 14 municipalities of Timor-Leste through 670Link kiosks, bus baggage, cargo and ferry. Fixed tariffs, OTP hand-over and WhatsApp updates.

calculator.title: Rate & Canal Calculator
calculator.description: Get an instant price for your parcel and see whether it travels by bus, cargo or sea ferry.

track.title: Track a Parcel
track.description: Follow your 670Send parcel step by step with its waybill number.

book.title: Book a Courier Pick-Up
book.description: Ask a 670Send courier to collect your parcels from your door. Drop a pin on the map.

terms.title: Terms of Service

home.schemesLead: Choose how your parcel gets to us — and how it reaches the other side.

schemeDesc.SCHEME_A: Drop it at a 670Link kiosk. The recipient collects it at the kiosk in the destination municipality.
schemeDesc.SCHEME_B: A courier collects it from you. The recipient collects it at the destination kiosk.
schemeDesc.SCHEME_C: Drop it at a kiosk. A local courier delivers it to the recipient’s address.
schemeDesc.SCHEME_D: Courier pick-up and courier delivery. We handle both ends.

s1.title: Hand it in
s1.body: Bring the parcel to a 670Link kiosk or book a courier. We check your ID and take two photos of the contents.

s2.title: Sealed and prepared
s2.body: The parcel is sealed, weighed and prepared at the hub for the right route.

s3.title: On the official fleet
s3.body: It travels with licensed bus, cargo and ferry partners that work under a written agreement with us.

s4.title: Arrives at the kiosk
s4.body: The recipient gets a WhatsApp message with a 6-digit OTP and the kiosk address.

s5.title: Hand-over with OTP and ID
s5.body: The recipient shows their ID and the OTP. We take a proof-of-delivery photo.

home.trustTitle: Made so parcels arrive — and so you can prove it

otp.body: Nobody can collect your parcel without the one-time code sent to the recipient.

terms.title: 670Send Terms of Service

declaration.title: Truthful Declaration & Criminal Liability
declaration.body: The sender warrants that the information about the contents is true and that the parcel contains no illegal or dangerous items. If prohibited items or a false declaration are discovered, the sender is fully liable under criminal and civil law and releases 670Send, Agents, Couriers and Fleet Partners from any legal claim.

inspection.title: Right of Inspection
inspection.body: 670Send and the competent authorities (PNTL / Customs) may open and inspect a parcel where there are indications of a security violation.

liability.title: Limited Liability
liability.body: Uninsured parcel: compensation is capped at 10 times the base shipping fee or USD 50.00, whichever is lower. Parcel with optional insurance (1% of value): compensation at the declared value, supported by a valid purchase receipt, up to USD 500.00 per waybill.

exclusions.title: Claim Exclusions
exclusions.body: Not covered: fragile items damaged by inadequate inner packaging, natural deterioration or spoilage, consequential loss, and force majeure (natural disasters, roads cut off or landslides on Timor-Leste's mountain routes).

claimDeadline.title: Claim Deadline
claimDeadline.body: Damage claims must be raised at hand-over in front of the destination Agent or Courier (before leaving the kiosk), with video or photo of the parcel being opened. Claims made after the parcel has been taken home are not valid.

identity.title: Identity and Hand-over
identity.body: The sender must show a valid ID (BI, voter card or passport) when handing in a parcel. The recipient collects with a valid ID and the one-time code (OTP) sent by WhatsApp; the hand-over is recorded with a photo.

storage.title: Storage at the Destination Kiosk
storage.body: A parcel waiting at the kiosk is stored free for the first 5 days. From day 6 to day 14 a storage fee of USD 0.50 per day applies, payable when collecting. A parcel not collected within 14 days returns to the Díli Hub and is handed back to the sender.

terms.intro: By handing a parcel to a 670Link agent or courier you accept these terms.

prohibited.title: Prohibited & Restricted Items
prohibited.intro: Agents and Couriers must refuse the items below. If smuggling is attempted, 670Send may report it to the PNTL.
prohibited.confirmHeading: I confirm this parcel does NOT contain:

items.narcotics: Narcotics, psychotropics and prohibited drugs (without Ministry of Health authorization)
items.weapons_sharp: Firearms, ammunition, explosives, fireworks and illegal bladed weapons
items.fuel_flammable: Fuel and flammable/corrosive liquids: petrol, diesel, kerosene, LPG cylinders, wet batteries, thinner, pressurized spray paint
items.cash_gold_jewelry: Cash, gold, high-value jewelry, blank cheques, state secret documents
items.protected_wildlife: Live animals and protected plants (including illegal animal parts)
items.untaxed_contraband: Untaxed contraband (illegal cigarettes or alcohol in commercial quantities)
items.raw_perishables: Fresh perishable food (raw meat, fresh fish, ice) without refrigeration

restricted.electronics: Electronics (phones, laptops, spare parts): rigid box with bubble wrap, declared value, insurance recommended.
restricted.documents: Important documents (diplomas, certificates, original contracts): waterproof pouch.
restricted.liquids: Non-hazardous liquids (coconut oil, honey, liquid medicine): maximum 1 litre, tightly sealed plastic bottle.

prohibited.footerNote: If in doubt, ask at the kiosk before you send. A false declaration makes the sender fully liable.
